name: dsh-narrative-ledger
description: Content-addressed timeline, canon and character-knowledge evidence for DSH

interface.shortDescription: Verify canon timelines and knowledge boundaries.
interface.longDescription: Checks content-addressed canon sources, ordered scene events, explicit fact assertion/retraction, single-value contradictions and what each character can know at a given point without storing story prose.
interface.defaultPrompt: Verify this narrative ledger and query its structural state without inventing story facts.
